description: A white plastic stand-like assembly sits on a blue bedspread in front of a pink pillow, with a few small white connector pieces off to the right. The left hand stays near the base to steady the stand as the right hand reaches in, pinches and lifts a small top connector from the stand (right-hand object), then moves it to the right and releases it beside the other loose parts, leaving the stand untouched by the right hand.
